 Home Local News Old Farmer’s Almanac predicts changing weather for Ohio in November Old Farmer’s Almanac predicts changing weather for Ohio in November
 Sat, October 31, 2026 by April King 
 SHARE NOW 
 Ohio could see a mix of rain, sunshine, and cooler temperatures around Thanksgiving, according to the latest long-range forecast from The Old Farmer’s Almanac .
 The publication released its Thanksgiving 2026 weather outlook, offering an early look at what Ohioans might expect as they prepare for the holiday and travel to visit family.
 For the Ohio Valley, including Cincinnati and surrounding areas, the forecast calls for scattered showers that could give way to sunshine in time for Thanksgiving Day on November 26.
 Temperatures are expected to turn cooler by the time the holiday arrives.
 Farther north, northern Ohio could see a chance of rain and snow during Thanksgiving week, along with chilly conditions.
 The forecast includes Cleveland in the Almanac’s Lower Lakes region, where wintry weather could affect holiday travel.
 The outlook suggests Ohio could experience different conditions depending on where residents live, with rain possible in some areas and a chance of snow farther north.
 While the forecast offers an early glimpse at the holiday weather, it is not a day-to-day prediction.
 Conditions can change as Thanksgiving approaches, and the Almanac encourages travelers to check updated local forecasts before heading out.
 For residents, the forecast is a reminder to prepare for changing late-November weather, especially if holiday travel is planned.
 The full Thanksgiving forecast is available at The Old Farmer’s Almanac website .
